key_points: Shopify and Meta signed a deal to integrate Shop Pay checkout into Meta's Muse AI agent across all Shopify-powered stores.
The partnership expands Shop Pay's reach, potentially increasing merchant transaction volume and take-rate revenue.
Shopify shares reacted positively, jumping ~7% on the announcement.
The deal positions Shopify at the forefront of AI-driven conversational commerce.
Analysts view the collaboration as a catalyst for medium-term growth, though not an earnings surprise.
